no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) for this NDA because no review issues were identified that raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment of pemigatinib for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the pemigatinib (PEMAZYRE) NDA213736. The Division stated it did not obtain the advice of the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) because no review issues raised significant public health questions about the risk:benefit assessment. Instead, two special government employees (an oncologist and a patient representative) were consulted individually by teleconference and both found the risk:benefit favorable, so there was no AdComm influence on the approval.
